test_keys: test the HDFStore.keys() method returns correct keys for stored Series and DataFrame objects
test_non_pandas_keys: test HDFStore.keys(include='native') returns non-pandas pytables entries while include='pandas' returns empty
test_keys_illegal_include_keyword_value: test HDFStore.keys() raises ValueError when include parameter is neither 'pandas' nor 'native'
test_keys_ignore_hdf_softlink: test HDFStore.keys() ignores HDF soft links and only returns actual pandas-stored tables
test_keys_iteration: test iterating over HDFStore directly yields the same keys as calling keys() method
